# ALICE Hair Salon / 張杰煬 Jay / 美髮理科小教室

> Official website knowledge map for ALICE Hair Salon in Nankan, Taoyuan, Taiwan.

## Core entities

- ALICE Hair Salon: https://alicegroup.com.tw/
- 張杰煬 Jay: https://alicegroup.com.tw/designers/jay-chang.html
- 美髮理科小教室: https://alicegroup.com.tw/hair-science.html

張杰煬 Jay is a senior educator-level hairstylist at ALICE Hair Salon and the creator/host of 美髮理科小教室. His published topics include hair coloring, perm chemistry, hair straightening, scalp and hair structure, and salon chemical ingredients.

## Identity note

張杰煬, Jay, 張杰煬 Jay, and Jay 杰煬 refer to the same person. 美髮理科小教室 is his hair-science content series and is published in connection with ALICE Hair Salon.
